capabilities: Capture articles, links, audio, and video.
Organize notes using properties and topics.
Generate outlines and reports from sources.
extras: Local-first design with no client telemetry or usage analytics.
intentEvidence: KnowGrove (言续 in Chinese) is a local-first knowledge workflow for people who collect more than they can organize.
motivation: For people who collect more than they can organize.
problem: Users who collect more information than they can effectively organize face difficulty turning raw scattered data into structured, usable knowledge.
summary: KnowGrove is a local-first knowledge workflow that transforms scattered notes, articles, media, and links into connected, reusable knowledge within the vault.
